body: Vercel warns that website/package.json engines.node = 22.x overrides its default Node 24.x. Change only the website package: website/package.json engines.node -> 24.x, website/.nvmrc -> 24, website/README.md Node wording, and spec .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 4 note on the Node row, D6, the 8.1 owner actions, the owner checklist, AC6, and the Vercel-vs-CI risk row). Root package.json engines (>=22.19.0) and the agb CLI test matrix stay on Node 22; the getting-started page documenting the CLI's Node >= 22.19.0 requirement is unchanged. Verify under Node 24: cd website && npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:site && npm test && node scripts/check-all.mjs, all passing; jq -r .engines.node website/package.json -> 24.x; cat website/.nvmrc -> 24. Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Build the docs site on Vercel's default Node 24.x instead of pinning 22.x
